FLIGHT MANUAL / 01

Make the opening.

01 / STEER

Move with mouse, WASD/arrow keys, direct drag, or the thumbstick. The paddle has a shallow vertical lane.

02 / UPSWING

Meet the ball while moving upward for a burst of speed. Paddle edges shape its exit angle.

03 / BREAK THROUGH

Keep a ball in the top zone to build combos, charge Overdrive, and make the board pay out.

04 / READ THE FIELD

Angle bricks need a glancing trajectory, speed bricks need momentum, and power bricks drop upgrades.

Catch the falling upgrades. F ignites a piercing fireball; × splits your ball; M briefly catches and relaunches it; W widens your paddle. Timed upgrades last 12 seconds and replace one another. Fill the charge meter for an 8-second Overdrive cascade with extra balls and rising rewards.

MOBILE PILOTSDrag anywhere on the field relative to its current position, or steer with your left thumb. Launch with the right button or a tap while waiting.
